title: Agent config
description: Per-user settings for bin/build.mjs. The configure skill and the settings page (node bin/ui.mjs) write this file; a missing file means every default below.

language.description: The language the agent replies in. Code, commits, and pull requests stay in English.

local.description: Optional Git repository whose root supplies local/.

repository.description: HTTPS or SSH Git URL. A normal build clones or fast-forwards local/; automatic builds never use the network. Existing edits and local commits are kept. Empty or null disables downloading without deleting local/.

disabled.description: Skills under skills/ that the build leaves out.

effort.description: Reasoning effort of Claude Code and Codex subagents. The main session keeps its own level.

build.description: oneshot-worker, which writes one plan task.

review.description: oneshot-reviewer, which runs prod-review on the finished change.

externalReview.description: Voices the external-review skill runs. Each needs its CLI and a subscription. Enabling a voice is consent to send it sanitized code from any repository. The agent a target serves is always left out of its own review.

timeoutMinutes.description: Minutes this voice may review before it is stopped and reported as timeout.
Minutes this voice may review before it is stopped and reported as timeout.
Minutes this voice may review before it is stopped and reported as timeout.
Minutes this voice may review before it is stopped and reported as timeout.

reviewBots.description: Review bots that run on the repository's side, as the pr-wait skill treats them. off ignores the bot, wait waits for it once it shows up on a pull request, request also posts its review comment after each push. Their comments are handled in every mode.

browser.description: Points Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor at Tencent BrowserSkill to drive your own Chrome in a background window. Needs the bsk CLI, its Chrome extension, and `bsk install-skill -H claude-code -H codex`.

attribution.description: Lets agents credit themselves in commits and pull requests. Off writes Claude Code's attribution as empty and turns off Cursor's commit and pull request attribution.

telemetry.description: Lets agents send usage data to their vendors. Off sets DISABLE_TELEMETRY for Claude Code and [analytics] enabled = false for Codex.

guard.description: Stops destructive commands in Claude Code and Codex. Refuses a force-push or delete of the default branch, a mirror push, and a recursive delete of /, the home directory, or a repository root. Asks before a hard reset, a forced clean, discarding every change, a forced branch delete, a stash drop, or any other force-push. Codex cannot ask, so it refuses those too.

autoCompact.description: When agents compact the conversation. Without tokens, each agent keeps its own default.

tokens.description: Claude Code's autoCompactWindow and Codex's model_auto_compact_token_limit.

release.description: Where an oneshot run ends. pr stops at a ready pull request. production also merges it and checks production, once the gate had nothing to settle, you answered it, or the run follows a plan you approved, in a feature as in a fix. A gate that took its own recommendations while you were away never releases, and a review of an existing pull request never merges.

orchestration.description: How an oneshot series runs its stages.

parallel.description: How many stages a series builds at once, counting those open before their merge is approved. A program.json can set its own.

targets.description: Which agent homes the build writes into.

codex.description: Codex. On by default when its dir exists.

cursor.description: Cursor. On by default when its dir exists.

gemini.description: Gemini CLI. On by default when its dir exists.

copilot.description: GitHub Copilot CLI. On by default when its dir exists.

opencode.description: OpenCode. Reads the Claude Code skills while that target is on, so it gets no copy of its own then. On by default when its dir exists.

grok.description: Grok Build. Reads the Claude Code skills while that target is on, so it gets no copy of its own then. On by default when its dir exists.
